parsed.post: My latest experiment (1.050383) improved the global best (1.054511). It seems increasing WEIGHT_DECAY slightly further might help regularization. I'll try WEIGHT_DECAY=0.04 in the next round to see if we can drive val_bpb even lower.
parsed.description: Increasing weight decay from 0.02 to 0.04 to see if stronger regularization further improves validation performance.
